description: Intent i002 (SNAPSHOT=s01, BRANCH=media-epidx) complete. Swept drivers/media/usb for fixed/assumed-index altsetting[..].endpoint[k].desc reads without a preceding bNumEndpoints>k validation. Four reported findings with exact source evidence: (1) HIGH — drivers/media/usb/usbvision/usbvision-video.c:1497-1515, a per-altsetting loop `for (i = 0; i < usbvision->num_alt; i++)` reads `uif->altsetting[i].endpoint[1].desc.wMaxPacketSize` with no per-iteration bNumEndpoints check (the only check, `bNumEndpoints < 2` at line 1458, covers only altsetting[0] of a possibly different interface), an exact structural clone of the seed cx231xx patch hunks; the OOB-read value feeds alt_max_pkt_size[i] which later sizes iso URB buffers. (2) MEDIUM — drivers/media/usb/dvb-usb/dib0700_core.c:829 `e = &intf->altsetting[0].endpoint[rc_ep].desc` with literal rc_ep=1 called from dib0700_probe line 891, zero bNumEndpoints validation in the function, gated only by device-reported fw_version >= 0x10200; programs bulk/int pipes and submits an URB at probe. (3) MEDIUM — drivers/media/usb/gspca/konica.c:191/209, sd_start reads endpoint[0] and (via i = n&1 ? 0 : 1) endpoint[1] of the negotiated altsetting with no bNumEndpoints check; core alt_xfer only guarantees >=1 endpoint, and packet_size directly sizes usb_alloc_coherent URB buffers. (4) MEDIUM — drivers/media/usb/b2c2/flexcop-usb.c:430, probe-path cur_altsetting->endpoint[0].desc.wMaxPacketSize with no bNumEndpoints check anywhere in the driver (legal bNumEndpoints==0 altsetting makes endpoint[0] OOB); frame_size sizes the iso coherent buffer. Evidence-backed safes (14): uvc (guarded by bNumEndpoints==1), usbtv (validates altsetting[1].bNumEndpoints==4), em28xx-cards/tm6000/stk1160/au0828/gspca-core/pwc/siano/em28xx-audio (all loops bounded by bNumEndpoints), gspca subdriver endpoint[0] reads on core-validated altsettings. Unresolved (2): stv06xx.c:338 and xirlink_cit.c:2658 intf_cache[0]->altsetting[1].endpoint[0] access — altsetting-count half owned by if-alt-count branch. Negative evidence bounded by literal `endpoint[` grep over drivers/media/usb in s01; smsusb.c:427 udev->ep_in[1] NULL-deref noted but out of branch scope. All candidates kept classified (reported/safe/unresolved); no runtime reproduction performed (read-only snapshot; findings are static hypotheses).
